title: Wokenv Configuration
description: Configuration file for the Wokenv WordPress development environment

type.description: What the project directory contains. Detected automatically when omitted. With plugin, theme or core the project is added to the wp-env configuration; none adds nothing.

mailpit.description: Catch the email WordPress sends with Mailpit: true (web UI on port 8025), false, or the port of the web UI.

image.description: Wokenv Docker image to run wp-env with. Must be a top-level, single-line value.

wp-env.description: A standard wp-env configuration: the same keys as .wp-env.json. Applied on top of the project's .wp-env.json, when there is one.
